name: Nginx
about: Serves files from the site folder by default. Supply .conf files in the config folder to define a reverse proxy or other server settings. Nginx has no web UI.

variables.label: Site folder
variables.description: Static files mounted read-only at /usr/share/nginx/html, readable by UID 101. The default config needs an index.html to serve requests for /.

variables.label: HTTP port
variables.description: Host port mapped to container port 80, where your server block must listen.

variables.label: Config folder
variables.description: Existing folder of .conf files mounted read-only at /etc/nginx/conf.d. These replace the default config and must include a server block. Leave blank to use the default site.

variables.label: HTTPS port
variables.description: Host port mapped to container port 443, which needs a server block with listen 443 ssl and certificate settings. Leave blank to omit it.

variables.label: Certificates folder
variables.description: Existing folder of certificates and keys mounted read-only at /etc/nginx/certs. Reference that path in your config. For Certbot, mount all of /etc/letsencrypt so certificate symlinks resolve.

variables.label: Timezone
variables.description: IANA name such as Europe/London. Sets the timestamps in the access and error logs.
